label: Digital transformation strategies, plans and policies
definition: Strategies, agendas and programmes for the digital transformation of the economy, government or a sector: digital agendas, digital-economy and e-commerce strategies, e-government and sector e-strategies, and the programmes that carry them out.
include_test: Does the money prepare or carry out a digital-transformation, digital-economy, e-government or sector digitalisation strategy or programme?

label: Data governance strategies, plans and policies
definition: Policies and frameworks for how public and private data are governed, shared, opened and used in policymaking.
include_test: Is it a data-governance, data-sharing, open-data or data-use policy or framework?

label: ICT and infrastructure strategies, plans and policies
definition: ICT-sector, telecommunications, broadband, postal and smart-city policy and strategy, and the regulatory frameworks and regulators' cooperation that serve them.
include_test: Is it policy, strategy or regulatory groundwork for the ICT, telecom, broadband or postal sector or its infrastructure?

label: Data protection strategies, plans and policies
definition: Privacy and personal-data protection policy, strategy and guidance.
include_test: Is it a privacy or personal-data protection policy, strategy or guidance?

label: AI strategies, plans and policies
definition: National and sector strategies, policies and plans for artificial intelligence.
include_test: Is it an AI strategy, policy or plan?

label: Cybersecurity strategies, plans and policies
definition: National cybersecurity strategies, policies and action plans.
include_test: Is it a cybersecurity strategy, policy or plan?

label: Digital sovereignty strategies, plans and policies
definition: Policies on digital and data sovereignty, including data localisation.
include_test: Is it a digital-sovereignty or data-localisation policy?

label: Interoperability strategies, plans and policies
definition: Interoperability frameworks, roadmaps and policies for government systems and data.
include_test: Is it an interoperability framework, roadmap or policy?

label: Cross-cutting strategies, plans and policies
definition: Digital policy work that spans several of the areas above or names none of them: the digital ministry and its agencies as bodies, programme coordination, pooled funds and digital-rights advocacy.
include_test: Use when the money serves the policy function as a whole or no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Data protection legislation
definition: Drafting, adopting and enforcing laws on privacy and personal data.
include_test: Is it a data-protection or privacy law or regulation?

label: Cybersecurity legislation
definition: Drafting, adopting and enforcing laws on cybersecurity and cybercrime.
include_test: Is it a cybersecurity or cybercrime law or legal framework?

label: Legislation covering digital ID
definition: Laws and regulations on identification, digital identity and SIM registration.
include_test: Is it an identity, digital-ID or SIM-registration law or regulation?

label: Digital payments legislation
definition: Making and enforcing the rules for digital payments and digital finance: payment and e-money law, regulators' and supervisors' capacity, consumer protection and redress, supervisory and regulatory technology, competition and AML/CFT rules.
include_test: Does the money make, or strengthen how others enforce, the rules for digital payments or digital financial services?

label: Legislation enabling data interoperability
definition: Laws and regulations that enable data sharing and exchange between systems.
include_test: Is it a law or regulation on interoperability, data sharing or data exchange?

label: AI legislation
definition: Laws and regulations on artificial intelligence.
include_test: Is it an AI law or regulation?

label: E-commerce legislation
definition: Laws and regulations on e-commerce, electronic transactions and signatures, and online advertising.
include_test: Is it an e-commerce, electronic-transactions or online-advertising law or regulation?

label: Statistics legislation
definition: Laws governing official statistics and the national statistical system.
include_test: Is it a statistics law or regulation?

label: Access to information legislation
definition: Laws on the public's right of access to information held by public bodies.
include_test: Is it an access-to-information law or regulation?

label: Cross-cutting legislation
definition: Digital law that spans several of the areas above or names none of them: digital and electronic-communications codes, sector legal texts, and the bodies and fees that enforce telecom rules.
include_test: Use when the law covers several areas or no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Data-protection authority
definition: The national data-protection authority or commission: its appropriation, transfers, levy share, staff, running costs, systems and supervision work.
include_test: Does the line fund the national data-protection regulator?

label: Agency compliance and audits
definition: A public body's own data-protection compliance: annual data audits, compliance consultants and implementing the regulation in a ministry.
include_test: Is the money spent by a ministry or agency to comply with data-protection rules?

label: Other data and online-safety oversight
definition: Oversight bodies and activities other than the data-protection authority: DNA-database boards, content classification and online safety, membership of international data-protection bodies, and skills building.
include_test: Is the line an oversight or protection activity that is not the national data-protection authority or an agency's compliance?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Regional digital integration
definition: Programmes run with or through regional bodies to integrate digital markets across borders: harmonised rules, cross-border connectivity and data flows, and shared digital services.
include_test: Does the line fund cross-border digital integration rather than a membership fee or a ministry's own international relations?

label: AfCFTA and digital trade
definition: Work under the African Continental Free Trade Area: its Digital Trade Protocol, putting it into effect, and the institutions and funds the AfCFTA runs.
include_test: Is the work done under or for the AfCFTA?

label: Memberships and contributions
definition: Subscriptions and statutory contributions to international and regional ICT bodies.
include_test: Is the money a subscription or contribution to an international body?

label: International ICT relations
definition: A ministry's international and regional ICT cooperation, partnerships, trade work and hosting of meetings.
include_test: Is the line about cooperation, partnerships or representation abroad rather than a membership fee?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Sector regulators and internet governance
definition: Telecoms, broadcasting and ICT regulators, country-code domain management and internet-governance work.
include_test: Does the line fund a sector regulator, domain registry or internet-governance activity?

label: Technical standards and assurance
definition: Setting ICT, security and architecture standards, certification authorities, IT audit and professional accreditation.
include_test: Does the line set, certify or audit against ICT standards?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Online civic space and expression
definition: Protecting and widening public debate online: freedom of expression and information integrity, countering hate speech and disinformation, digital-democracy initiatives and multi-stakeholder internet forums.
include_test: Does the money buy activity that protects or widens open public debate online?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Mobile and access networks
definition: Building, upgrading and running the networks that connect end users: mobile radio networks and 4G/5G rollout, fibre-to-the-home, fixed-wireless and internet-service-provider networks, the towers and shared sites they run on, and finance raised by the operators that run them.
include_test: Does the money build, upgrade or finance a public network serving end users, rather than a backbone, coverage of unserved areas or one body's own premises?

label: Ministry and programme administration
definition: Ministry directorates, programmes and staff running telecom and digital-infrastructure policy, where the line buys no specific network.
include_test: Is it the running costs, pay or programme envelope of a telecom or digital-infrastructure ministry unit?

label: Backbone, bandwidth and satellites
definition: National fibre backbones, metropolitan networks, cross-border terrestrial links, international bandwidth and communications satellites.
include_test: Is it national-scale carrier infrastructure that the whole country's networks ride on?

label: Submarine cables
definition: Submarine cable systems, their landing stations and capacity bought on them.
include_test: Is the money for a submarine cable, a landing station or capacity on one?

label: Internet exchange points
definition: Internet exchange points and the national internet nodes where networks swap local traffic.
include_test: Is the money for an exchange point or national internet node?

label: Digital broadcasting
definition: Terrestrial radio and television transmission networks and the analogue-to-digital switchover.
include_test: Does the line pay for broadcast transmission or digital TV migration?

label: Government-wide network
definition: Shared networks that connect the administration as a whole: government intranets and WANs, interconnection of ministries and the shared government ICT infrastructure.
include_test: Does the network serve many public bodies rather than one body's own offices?

label: A body's own network and internet
definition: One public body's own LAN, WAN across its sites, campus network, leased lines, internet bandwidth and office telephony.
include_test: Is it one ministry, agency, university or hospital connecting its own premises or paying its own internet and telephone bills?

label: State telecom and postal operators
definition: Subsidies, equity, arrears and rehabilitation of state-owned telecom and postal operators and regional operator bodies.
include_test: Is the recipient a state-owned or regional telecom or postal operating company?

label: Multi-part digital programmes
definition: Digital development programmes that fund connectivity alongside digital government, skills, digital finance or other components, not reducible to one network.
include_test: Does the money fund a package in which connectivity is only one of several components?

label: Regulation and spectrum
definition: Telecom and communications regulators, spectrum and numbering management, licensing and traffic monitoring.
include_test: Does the line fund a regulator or the management of spectrum, licences or operator traffic?

label: Security and military networks
definition: Dedicated radio and transmission networks of the armed forces, police, intelligence and command administration.
include_test: Is it a network run for or by security, defence or command services rather than for general office use?

label: Universal access and rural coverage
definition: Extending coverage to unserved areas, rural and last-mile sites, school connectivity schemes and universal-service funds.
include_test: Is the money aimed at places or users that operators leave unserved, or paid through a universal-service fund?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Commercial data centres and cloud
definition: Colocation, carrier-neutral and hyperscale data centres and cloud regions built to sell hosting, storage or computing capacity to many customers.
include_test: Is the facility run to sell capacity to outside customers rather than to host one body's or the government's own systems?

label: Backup and disaster recovery
definition: Off-site backup, disaster-recovery and business-continuity sites for government data and systems.
include_test: Is the purpose a secondary or recovery site, backup or continuity capability?

label: A body's own data centre and servers
definition: One ministry's, agency's or sector's own data centre, server room, hosting and data repository.
include_test: Is the facility or hosting for one body or one sector's data?

label: Government data centres and cloud
definition: National or whole-of-government data centres, government hosting and cloud platforms that serve many bodies.
include_test: Is the facility or platform meant to host systems for the government at large?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Power for digital infrastructure
definition: Electricity supply, including off-grid solar, for data centres, networks and government ICT.
include_test: Does the line pay for power supply to digital infrastructure?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Government computing capacity
definition: IT equipment and computing capacity bought to keep government systems running, where no other infrastructure topic fits.
include_test: Does it buy general IT equipment or computing power for government use?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Cybercrime enforcement and forensics
definition: Police, judicial and intelligence units that investigate cybercrime, and digital-forensic laboratories and tools.
include_test: Is it a law-enforcement, prosecution or intelligence capability against cybercrime or for digital evidence?

label: Fraud detection and prevention
definition: Shared tools and services that detect and stop fraud in payment and digital financial systems.
include_test: Is it a tool or service for spotting and stopping fraud across a payment or financial system?

label: National cyber agencies and CERTs
definition: National cybersecurity authorities, councils, CERTs and CSIRTs, government security operations centres and protection of critical national infrastructure.
include_test: Does it fund a national body or service that protects cyberspace beyond a single ministry?

label: Securing a body's own systems
definition: Firewalls, antivirus, security software, network hardening, backups and security audits for one body's own IT.
include_test: Is the protection bought for one ministry's or agency's own networks, applications or data?

label: Digital trust and PKI
definition: Public key infrastructure, electronic certification and trust services that let people and systems prove identity and integrity online.
include_test: Does it fund certification authorities, PKI or electronic signature trust services?

label: Strategy, awareness and skills
definition: National cybersecurity strategies and action plans, public awareness campaigns, and cybersecurity training.
include_test: Is it policy drafting, a campaign, a workshop or a training scheme rather than an operating security service?

label: Surveillance and interception
definition: Lawful interception, phone tracking, geolocation, public video surveillance and similar monitoring systems of the security services.
include_test: Does it buy tools to watch, track or intercept people or communications rather than to protect systems?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Government interoperability platforms
definition: Platforms and links that let government systems exchange data with each other: interoperability layers, service buses, database interconnections and police or statistical data-sharing networks.
include_test: Does the line connect two or more government systems or agencies so they exchange data?

label: Open data-sharing networks
definition: Protocols, frameworks and networks through which many independent providers exchange data or transactions: open finance, open transaction networks and cross-sector knowledge exchanges.
include_test: Does it set up a shared protocol or framework for many providers, public or private, to exchange data or transactions?

label: Spatial data infrastructure
definition: National spatial data infrastructure and the shared geospatial datasets it serves.
include_test: Is the exchange specifically of geospatial or satellite data?

label: Trade single windows
definition: Electronic single windows and connected customs platforms through which traders and border agencies exchange documents.
include_test: Is the platform a single window or interconnection for trade, customs or border clearance?

label: Data-exchange governance and standards
definition: Rules, frameworks and standards for exchanging data between systems and institutions: data-governance and data-sharing frameworks, interoperability standards and the bodies that set them.
include_test: Does the money set the rules or standards for exchanging data, rather than build a platform?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic's test can be answered.

label: Biometric identification systems
definition: Automated fingerprint and biometric identification systems, biometric enrolment of a group and forensic or criminal identification.
include_test: Is the money for a biometric matching system (AFIS/ABIS), a fingerprint file or biometric enrolment of a group?

label: Civil registration
definition: Registration of births, deaths, marriages and other vital events and the civil-status services that record them.
include_test: Is the line only about civil registration or civil status, with no national ID card or register named?

label: Combined civil registration and ID
definition: Bodies and systems that run both civil registration of vital events and national identity in one line.
include_test: Does the line cover both civil registration (births, deaths, marriages) and national ID or the population register?

label: Sector and functional identifiers
definition: Identifiers issued for one purpose rather than as foundational ID: pupil IDs, voter registers, SIM registration, driving licences, staff and pensioner biometrics, guards and licence-holders.
include_test: Does the identifier serve one sector or programme (school, election, telecoms, payroll, licensing) rather than identify the whole population?

label: National ID and population registers
definition: Foundational national identity: identity agencies, population registers, unique identifiers, enrolment and the production and issue of national identity cards.
include_test: Is the money for the national ID system, its register, unique identifier or identity cards?

label: Passports, visas and border systems
definition: Passports, visas, residence permits and other travel documents, and the immigration and border-control systems that issue or check them.
include_test: Is the money for travel or immigration documents, or for immigration and border-control systems?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Agent and merchant networks
definition: Cash-in cash-out agents and the merchants who accept digital payments: building, financing, training and measuring those networks.
include_test: Does the money expand or improve the agents and merchants through whom people use digital money?

label: Digital banking and institution digitisation
definition: Digital-only banks, and banks, microfinance institutions and financial cooperatives moving accounts and services onto digital channels.
include_test: Does the money build a digital bank or put a financial institution's own services online?

label: Digital revenue collection
definition: Systems that let people and firms pay government digitally: e-payment of taxes and fees, cashless counters and treasury links to payment systems.
include_test: Is money flowing to government through a digital channel?

label: Digital government payouts
definition: Paying people from government digitally: salaries by mobile money, e-vouchers for farm inputs and other transfers.
include_test: Is money flowing from government to people or firms through a digital channel?

label: Digital finance research and skills
definition: Research, evaluation, data and professional training on digital financial services and their users.
include_test: Is the money mainly for studying digital finance or training the people who run and regulate it?

label: Fintech investment funds
definition: Pooled vehicles that invest in or lend to many financial-services and fintech firms.
include_test: Is the money committed to a fund, rather than to one firm, whose portfolio is financial services or fintech?

label: Financial-inclusion programmes
definition: Broad programmes, strategies and intermediaries widening access to and use of financial services, including for women and the poor, where no single channel is named.
include_test: Is it a financial-inclusion programme, strategy or advocacy effort that spans several channels?

label: Digital insurance
definition: Insurance sold, administered or claimed through digital channels, and the schemes fostering such insurers.
include_test: Is the money for insurance delivered digitally?

label: Digital credit and asset finance
definition: Credit delivered or scored digitally: digital and point-of-sale lending, invoice and working-capital finance, pay-as-you-go asset finance and alternative-data credit scoring.
include_test: Is the money for lending through a digital channel, or for the data and scoring that price such loans?

label: Payment and mobile-money providers
definition: Firms that move money for people and businesses: mobile-money operators, wallets, payment gateways, processors and merchant-acceptance platforms.
include_test: Is the money for a payment or mobile-money service run by one provider, rather than a shared national or regional system?

label: Payment rails and financial services
definition: Shared payment infrastructure and its providers: national switches and payment systems, postal and cooperative financial services, cashless ticketing schemes and their oversight.
include_test: Is the line building or running payment infrastructure used by many payers rather than one government flow?

label: Remittances and cross-border payments
definition: Sending money between countries: remittance services, cross-border payment providers and corridors, and the rules for monitoring them.
include_test: Does the money serve payments that cross a border?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic's test can be answered.

label: Address registers
definition: National addressing and postcode systems and address registers.
include_test: Does the line build or run street addresses, postcodes or an address register?

label: Vehicle, animal and asset registers
definition: Registers of movable things and public property: vehicles, livestock, boats, insurance cover and state assets.
include_test: Does the register record vehicles, animals, boats or public property rather than people or land?

label: Business and organisation registers
definition: Registers of legal entities and their rights: companies, business names, trade registers, one-stop shops, intellectual property, security interests, associations and firm databases.
include_test: Does the register record companies, organisations, their identifiers or their registered rights?

label: Civil and population registers
definition: Registers of persons and vital events: births, deaths, marriages, civil status and population or resident registers.
include_test: Does the register record people's vital events or residence for the whole population?

label: Voter registers
definition: Electoral rolls and the enrolment of voters.
include_test: Does the line compile or maintain the voters' register?

label: Base maps and geodetic data
definition: The spatial reference that registers sit on: base-map and cartographic databases, geodetic networks, aerial mapping and national geospatial data services.
include_test: Is the spending on maps, geodesy or general geospatial data rather than a register of parcels or people?

label: Land and property registers
definition: Registers of land parcels and rights: cadastre, land titles and deeds, land information systems, valuation rolls and state land.
include_test: Does the register record land parcels, titles, deeds or land rights?

label: Other registers of people
definition: Registers of particular groups of people kept for one purpose: learners and qualifications, skills, farmers, prisoners, criminal records, military census, driving-licence sanctions.
include_test: Does the register list a specific group of people for one administration rather than the whole population?

label: Social registries
definition: Household and beneficiary registers used to target social assistance.
include_test: Is the register used to identify poor or vulnerable households for social programmes?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic's test can be answered.

label: Health information systems
definition: Health-sector systems: HMIS and DHIS2, patient and hospital records, telemedicine, laboratory and blood systems, health insurance and disease surveillance.
include_test: Does the system serve health care or public health?

label: Education information systems
definition: Education-sector systems: EMIS, student, admissions and examination records, and school and university management.
include_test: Does the system serve schools, universities or training?

label: Justice, police and security systems
definition: Systems of courts, prosecutors, prisons, police and border agencies: case management, criminal records, investigations and financial intelligence.
include_test: Does the system serve justice, policing or security?

label: Agriculture information systems
definition: Systems serving farming, livestock and fisheries: extension and advisory, agricultural market information and agro-climatic services.
include_test: Does the system serve agriculture?

label: Social protection and labour systems
definition: Systems that run benefits, social assistance and social security, and labour-market information.
include_test: Does the system serve social protection, welfare or employment?

label: Land, environment and natural-resource systems
definition: Systems built on place or physical observation: land and cadastre, GIS and planning, water, weather, forestry, environment, mining and energy resources.
include_test: Does the system serve land, the environment or natural resources?

label: Economic, trade and industry systems
definition: Systems of trade, industry, investment, tourism and economic ministries: market and trade information, investor services and economic data.
include_test: Does the system serve trade, industry or economic management?

label: Transport systems
definition: Systems of transport ministries and agencies other than asset and traffic operations: road-safety, licensing and transport data.
include_test: Does the system serve transport?

label: Other sector systems
definition: Information systems of sectors not listed above, such as interior, culture, elections or the presidency.
include_test: Is it a sector system whose sector has no sub-topic of its own?

label: Asset and operations systems
definition: Systems that run physical operations and assets: fleet and vehicles, road and state asset management, stores and supply chain, ticketing, traffic, port and aviation operations, metering and tracking.
include_test: Does the system manage physical assets, goods, vehicles or an operational service flow?

label: Financial and revenue systems
definition: Systems that run public money: budget preparation and execution, accounting and treasury (IFMIS), audit, procurement, debt and investment management, and tax and customs administration.
include_test: Does the system's main job record or move public money, raise revenue or control spending?

label: HR and payroll systems
definition: Systems that manage public staff: personnel records, payroll, pensions, staff verification, attendance and staff performance management.
include_test: Is the system about the state's own employees, their pay, pensions or appraisal?

label: Strategy, standards and coordination
definition: Roadmaps, standards, global-goods coordination and research that shape sector information systems, rather than building or running one system.
include_test: Is the output a roadmap, standard, coordination effort or study rather than a working information system?

label: Unspecified
definition: Systems whose sector and function cannot be read from the line.
include_test: Use only when neither the line nor its spending body names a sector or a function.

label: Finance, HR and procurement systems
definition: Systems that run government's own back office: public-finance and budget systems (IFMIS and equivalents), accounting, payroll and HR management, procurement and asset management.
include_test: Is the system one that manages the administration's own money, staff, purchases or assets rather than the service the body delivers?

label: Online services and procedures
definition: Putting services or administrative procedures online for citizens or businesses: e-services portals, one-stop windows, online applications, e-procedures and dematerialisation. Includes a body's website and online communication.
include_test: Does the line put a service or procedure that the public uses online, or run a portal through which the public transacts?

label: In-house IT unit
definition: Staff, running costs and support of one body's own IT unit or directorate, booked as an organisational unit rather than a project.
include_test: Does the line pay for an IT unit, directorate, centre or IT staff of a single ministry or body, as a unit?

label: Hardware, software and licences
definition: Buying, maintaining or licensing computers, office ICT equipment, software and databases, with no specific system named.
include_test: Is what is bought IT equipment, software or licences as goods, not a named system or service?

label: Digital transformation programmes
definition: Multi-part digitalisation or administrative-modernisation programmes for a body or for government, not reducible to one system or service. Includes digitising a body's records, archives and document management.
include_test: Does the line fund a digital-transformation, computerisation or e-government programme spanning several components?

label: Digital skills of public servants
definition: Training and capacity building that raise officials' ability to run digital government, without building a system.
include_test: Is the money mainly for training or capacity building of public officials in digital work?

label: Business information systems
definition: Building, running or upgrading the application systems a body uses for its own work: a ministry's information system, finance, procurement, HR, case-management or other single-function systems, and IT master plans.
include_test: Is the line about one administration's information system or a named application for one government function?

label: Unspecified
definition: GovTech lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic's test can be applied.

label: Local in-house IT units
definition: IT units of provincial, regional or local administrations, and recurrent ICT money passed down to local authorities.
include_test: Is the line an IT unit or general ICT allocation of a sub-national administration?

label: Local government systems
definition: Named systems and digitisation programmes for councils: revenue management, monitoring and reporting, council management and records, smart-city projects.
include_test: Does the line build or run a specific system or digitisation programme for local governments?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic's test can be answered.

label: Rural digitalisation
definition: Projects that bring digital tools to rural economies and services, here almost all agricultural.
include_test: Is the line a digitalisation programme aimed at rural areas or farming?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines too vague to place.
include_test: Use only when the line is not about rural digitalisation.

label: AI in government use
definition: Deploying AI systems in public services, security forces or ministry projects.
include_test: Does the line buy or build an AI system for a government function?

label: AI datasets and language models
definition: Building open datasets, language and voice models and tools, especially for African languages, as shared resources.
include_test: Does the money create data or models that others can build AI on?

label: AI firms and compute
definition: AI companies and the infrastructure they sell: investment in firms building AI products, AI factories, GPU clusters and corporate AI centres.
include_test: Is the money capital for an AI business or commercial AI computing capacity?

label: AI institutes and research
definition: National AI institutes, research centres and laboratories, and the compute and data centres they run.
include_test: Is the money for a dedicated AI or data-science research body or its facilities?

label: AI policy and promotion
definition: AI strategies, ministry AI units and councils, and schemes promoting AI and emerging technologies in the economy.
include_test: Is it AI strategy, coordination, a ministry AI unit or a promotion scheme?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Ministry and programme administration
definition: Staff, running costs and unnamed transfers of a ministry's digital-economy programme.
include_test: Is it the running cost, pay or general envelope of a digital-economy programme?

label: E-commerce and digital trade
definition: Promoting electronic commerce, e-merchants, technology trade and digital exports.
include_test: Is the line about selling goods or services online or trade in technology?

label: Investment in technology firms
definition: Equity, loans and acquisitions in established companies producing digital goods or services, their engineering centres, and the growth funds that buy into them.
include_test: Is the money capital put into a technology company, or into a fund investing in such companies beyond the start-up stage?

label: Digital sector bodies and firm support
definition: Sector chambers and professional bodies, and schemes helping firms or media industries adopt or produce digital technology.
include_test: Is it support to the digital industry or its firms through a sector body or adoption scheme?

label: Tech zones and technopoles
definition: Special economic zones, free zones and technopoles built to attract ICT and technology firms.
include_test: Does the money develop a zone or technopolis meant for technology industry?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Ministry and programme administration
definition: Directorates, programme envelopes and staff of the ministry unit promoting innovation and the digital economy.
include_test: Is it the running cost, pay or programme envelope of an innovation or digital-economy unit?

label: Tech events and promotion
definition: National digital weeks, forums, summits and other technology events.
include_test: Is the line for staging or attending a technology event?

label: Tech parks, hubs and incubators
definition: Building and running technology parks, innovation hubs, incubators, digital villages and smart-city pilots.
include_test: Does the money build or run a physical place where tech firms or innovators work?

label: Research and emerging technology
definition: Research and development projects, technology labs and pilots of emerging technologies, and innovation observatories or databases.
include_test: Does it pay for research, a lab, or a trial of a new technology?

label: Start-up and innovator support
definition: Grants, funds, prizes and support schemes for start-ups, small ICT businesses and individual innovators.
include_test: Is the money paid to or for start-ups, small digital firms or innovators as beneficiaries?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Civil-service digital literacy
definition: Basic digital literacy for civil servants, including training rooms for them.
include_test: Is the literacy effort aimed at civil servants?

label: E-learning platforms and content
definition: E-learning portals, learning management systems, online courses and digital learning content.
include_test: Is the money for an e-learning platform, online course or digital teaching content?

label: E-libraries and e-resources
definition: Electronic libraries, law libraries, e-books, e-journals and database subscriptions for staff, students or researchers.
include_test: Is the money for an e-library, digital reference collection or e-resource subscription?

label: Public digital literacy and awareness
definition: Basic computer and digital literacy for the general public, digital awareness campaigns, digital weeks and days, and the agencies that promote them.
include_test: Is the effort aimed at the public at large: basic skills, awareness or promotion events?

label: ICT in schools
definition: Computers, connected classrooms, digital devices and ICT integration in primary and secondary teaching, and training teachers in digital literacy.
include_test: Is the money for using ICT in school teaching or for teachers' digital literacy?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Digital skills for enterprises
definition: Training entrepreneurs, MSMEs, traders and cooperatives in digital marketing, e-commerce and digital business adoption.
include_test: Is the training aimed at businesses or entrepreneurs, or about selling and marketing online?

label: ICT higher education and institutes
definition: Universities, faculties, virtual universities and specialised ICT, telecoms and computing schools and institutes, with their staff, running costs, buildings, scholarships and student grants.
include_test: Does the line fund a higher-education or vocational institution that teaches ICT, or places and scholarships in it?

label: Public-sector staff ICT training
definition: Training civil servants and an organisation's own staff in ICT, software, data analysis, IT audit and professional IT certification.
include_test: Is the training for government staff, or the organisation's own employees?

label: ICT in schools and teacher training
definition: Digital and ICT skills in secondary and technical-vocational education, including training teachers to teach with or about ICT.
include_test: Is the training aimed at school pupils, TVET learners or teachers?

label: Youth and community digital-skills programmes
definition: Digital, coding, AI and ICT skills programmes for young people, women, job seekers and communities, often with starter kits or devices.
include_test: Is the training for young people, women, job seekers or community members at large?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Research cyberinfrastructure and libraries
definition: Computing, networks, storage and libraries that serve researchers.
include_test: Is the money for computers, high-performance computing, networks or libraries for research?

label: ICT research institutes
definition: Public research institutes and centres for ICT, electronics and computing, and grants to them.
include_test: Does the line fund a research institute or centre working on ICT or electronics?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Public access centres
definition: Telecentres, cyber centres, community digital centres, post-office service points and libraries offering public internet access.
include_test: Does it build or run a place where the public goes to get online?

label: Devices for users
definition: Subsidies and programmes putting laptops, tablets or other devices in the hands of pupils, students or citizens.
include_test: Is the money for devices given or subsidised to individual users?

label: Digital inclusion programmes
definition: National programmes promoting digital inclusion, local content and use of online services, including for vulnerable groups.
include_test: Is it an inclusion or uptake programme not tied to a specific access centre, device scheme or fund?

label: Universal access funds
definition: Universal-service and universal-access funds and transfers whose remit is extending ICT access.
include_test: Is it a universal-service or universal-access fund, or a transfer under that heading?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Gender digital divide
definition: Closing the gap between women and men in digital access, skills and use: women's and girls' connectivity, digital skills, digital financial services and participation in the digital economy.
include_test: Is the line aimed at narrowing a gender gap in digital access, skills or use?

label: Digital inclusion programmes
definition: National programmes, offices and studies promoting digital adoption and social inclusion.
include_test: Is it a general programme or study on digital adoption or inclusion?

label: Youth and school digital programmes
definition: ICT clubs, youth centres and youth foundations that bring digital skills and use to young people.
include_test: Is the programme aimed at young people or school pupils?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say what kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Does no other sub-topic of this topic fit on the line's own words?

label: Censuses
definition: Complete enumerations: population and housing, agricultural, enterprise and other censuses, including preparation and counterpart funding.
include_test: Does the line name a census or a full enumeration?

label: Coordination, methods and standards
definition: Running the national statistical system: statistics strategies and master plans, councils and committees, methodology, sampling frames, classifications, quality assurance and regional harmonisation.
include_test: Does the line coordinate, plan or set rules and methods for statistics rather than collect or publish them?

label: Statistical capacity programmes
definition: Multi-year programmes that strengthen a statistics office or national statistical system on several fronts at once: management, production, dissemination, data infrastructure and staff skills. Includes schools and courses that train statisticians.
include_test: Does the line fund broad strengthening of a statistical system rather than one census, survey, system, course or the office's running costs?

label: Statistics office running costs
definition: The national statistics office or a census bureau funded as a body: its appropriation, grants, pay, running costs, buildings, regional offices and corporate services.
include_test: Does the line pay for the statistics office as an institution rather than for a named census, survey, system or statistical product?

label: Statistical production and dissemination
definition: The statistics office's production of official statistics by domain (national accounts, prices, economic, social and demographic statistics) and their analysis, publication and outreach.
include_test: Does the line produce, analyse or publish a body of official statistics, without naming one census or survey?

label: Line-ministry statistics units
definition: Statistics, research and information units inside line ministries and agencies other than the statistics office, and their administrative statistics, digests and yearbooks.
include_test: Is the statistics work done by a ministry or agency other than the national statistics office, and not a named survey, census or system?

label: Sample surveys
definition: Household, labour-force, demographic and health, living-conditions, agricultural, business and other sample surveys, including the collection of price data.
include_test: Does the line name a sample survey or a regular field data collection?

label: Statistical databases and IT
definition: Statistical information systems, databases, data platforms, statistical software, IT equipment and geographic information systems built for statistics.
include_test: Is the money for a database, information system, software or IT that holds or processes statistics?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Archives and heritage digitisation
definition: Digitising and conserving archives, audiovisual and film heritage, museum collections and court or historical records.
include_test: Does the line digitise or conserve archives, heritage collections or historical records?

label: Open data, transparency portals and dashboards
definition: Public-facing portals, websites and publications that put government data, budgets or laws online for anyone to use. Includes dashboards, scorecards and trackers that follow projects and results.
include_test: Is the output a portal or publication open to the public, or the coordination of open data?

label: Sector databases and data banks
definition: Databases, data banks, data centres, repositories and data platforms that hold a sector's or agency's data.
include_test: Is the money for building, upgrading or running a database, data bank or repository?

label: Right to information
definition: Bodies and activities that administer, enforce or promote the right of access to information held by public bodies.
include_test: Does the line fund an access-to-information commission or promote access-to-information law?

label: Skills and training
definition: Training staff or the public in data management, analysis and statistical or dashboard tools.
include_test: Is the line mainly training people to handle or analyse data?

label: Unspecified
definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.

label: Mapping and remote-sensing agencies
definition: National mapping, cartography, remote-sensing and geospatial institutes funded as bodies, and their core map and imagery production.
include_test: Does the line fund a national mapping or remote-sensing body, or national topographic mapping?

label: Geospatial data infrastructure and platforms
definition: Shared infrastructure that makes satellite and geospatial data usable for many purposes: spatial data infrastructures, data cubes, open imagery services and multi-purpose geospatial analytics platforms.
include_test: Does the line build or run geospatial data infrastructure for many users rather than one sector's application?

label: Positioning reference networks
definition: GNSS continuously operating reference stations and geodetic positioning networks.
include_test: Is the money for CORS/GNSS reference stations or a geodetic network?

label: Sector GIS and mapping projects
definition: Geographic information systems, geospatial mapping and remote-sensing applications built for one sector's use: roads, land, utilities, minerals, farming, forests, hazards and the like.
include_test: Is the line a GIS, mapping or imagery project for a particular sector's assets or resources?

label: Skills and training
definition: Training people in geospatial data gathering, GIS or remote sensing.
include_test: Is the line mainly training people in geospatial or remote-sensing skills?

label: Space agencies and satellites
definition: Space agencies, earth-observation satellites and their ground stations and launch programmes.
include_test: Does the line fund a space agency, a satellite or a satellite ground station?

definition: Lines whose text does not say which kind of activity the money buys.
include_test: Use only when no other sub-topic of this topic can be read from the line.
